Natural Sciences

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

Natural Sciences at Radboud combines physics, chemistry and biology to investigate scientific problems across their boundaries. Students develop mathematical and experimental skills before specialising in physical chemistry, biophysics or biochemistry.

UCR offers useful study in biochemistry, molecular biology, environmental science, mathematics and data analysis. These courses do not sustain the combination of physical theory, chemistry and laboratory work that defines this degree. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Physical Chemistry specialisation

The selected 180 EC route includes 60 EC in the first year, 30 EC of later shared courses, 33 EC of required Physical Chemistry courses, 39 EC of restricted specialisation electives, 6 EC of free electives and a 12 EC individual research internship. Where the regulations allow alternatives, the first listed current course is shown. Biophysics and Biochemistry are separate routes. First-year Academic Skills and language-test participation add no credits. The internship has prior-study and approval requirements. The programme is formally Dutch, with most courses taught in English.
